name: confirm-intent-output
description: Enforces an adaptive pre-run intent/input/expected-output header and a post-run actual-output and scope-delta footer across Claude, Gemini, Grok, ChatGPT, and coding agents so every turn can be tracked and visualized in real time.
guidelines: **Pre-Run Contract Header**: Before answering any non-trivial request, emit a compact `[Flow Contract | Pre-Run]` blockquote stating `Goal`, `Input`, `Expected Output`, and `Gate`.

**Adaptive Confirmation Gate**: Proceed directly after stating the Pre-Run contract when the request is clear; pause to ask the user for confirmation ONLY when requirements are ambiguous or the task carries high cost or destructive impact.
**Post-Run Contract Footer**: At the end of the response, emit a compact `[Flow Contract | Post-Run]` blockquote stating `Actual Output`, `Delta`, `Delta Note`, and optional `Extras`.

**Honest Scope Delta Classification**: Classify `Delta` strictly as `Matched` (delivered as expected), `Expanded` (delivered expected output plus extra research findings or edge cases), `Pivoted` (approach changed based on new findings or user direction), or `Partial` (blocked or incomplete).

**Normalize Research Expansion**: Treat `Expanded` as a normal, healthy outcome during deep investigation or research rather than forcing output to stay artificially small; list bonus discoveries in `Extras` separated by semicolons.
**Skip Ceremony on Trivial Queries**: Omit both contract blocks for quick one-line factual lookups or greetings so everyday chat remains friction-free.
